children.value: > Fact From Story: The lawsuit argues that Google "siphons off" news publishers' content, readers, and ad revenue through anticompetitive means, including AI technologies.
> > Fact From Story: The suit points to Google’s older question-and-answer technologies, like the “Knowledge Graph” launched in May 2012, as part of the problem.
> > > > > Fact From Story: By 2020, the Knowledge Graph had grown to 500 billion facts about 5 billion entities. | Fact From Story
> > > > > Commonsense Knowledge: A database of 500 billion facts is a massive database. | Commonsense Knowledge

> > Fact From Story: The case, filed by Arkansas-based publisher Helena World Chronicle, argues that Google is "starving the free press" by sharing publishers' content on Google, losing them "billions of dollars."
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Sharing content without permission and causing financial loss can be considered anticompetitive behavior.
> Fact From Story: A new class action lawsuit accuses Google of anticompetitive behavior in violation of U.S. antitrust law.
> > Fact From Story: The case was filed by Arkansas-based publisher Helena World Chronicle.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Companies can sue other companies.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Antitrust laws are designed to promote competition and prevent monopolies from harming consumers and businesses.
